description: A tiled seaside promenade at night, lit by the lights of souvenir stalls. Racks of sunglasses and rows of straw sun hats stand outside the shops on one side, dark pine trees rise on the other, and the lights of the bay glow further along. A young couple walks away from the camera down the promenade with his arm around her shoulders. He reaches over and ruffles the top of her head; she ducks away, spins round with her blonde hair flying, and laughs. He puts his arm back around her and they walk on together past the stalls.

en.question: Who is walking past the hats?
